update.setting: Check for updates when TRACE starts
update.settingHint: Makes one request to github.com, sends nothing about you or your files and never installs anything.
update.openFailed: The download page could not be opened.
network.title: Network
network.intro: TRACE uses the internet only for the features listed here. Every request is recorded in the activity list below, and nothing about your boards, notes or documents is ever sent.
network.updateCheckHint: Asks for the latest release when TRACE starts (if the switch above is on) or when you press Check now.
network.activityIntro: Every request since TRACE started, newest first. Only the host and the path are shown, never a query, a header or an answer. The list lives in memory and is gone when TRACE closes.
network.activityCaption: Network requests since TRACE started, newest first
network.activityEmpty: No network request since TRACE started.
network.activityLoadFailed: The network activity could not be read.
network.bugReportHint: A report is sent only after you choose Send in the report form.
